questions.q: What did the bear, the pig and the fox decide to do together?
o: Plough a field and sow wheat
questions.e: “Dogovore se da oru zemlju i da siju pšenicu” — they agreed to plough and sow wheat.

questions.q: What did the fox use to work in the field?
questions.e: The fox: “Ja ću mojim repom podrljati” — she harrowed with her tail.

questions.q: How did the bear divide the grain?
o: He gave the pig only straw, took the wheat himself and gave the fox nothing
He gave it all to the pig
He gave it all to the fox
questions.e: He gave the pig only straw, took the wheat himself, and gave the fox nothing.

questions.q: How did the fox threaten the bear and the pig?
o: She said she would complain to the wolf
She said she would bring an emperor's man to divide the grain fairly
She said she would take the grain by force
She said she would burn the threshing floor
questions.e: The fox says she will bring an emperor's man who will divide the grain fairly.

questions.q: Who did the fox actually bring?
questions.e: “Lisica otide te nađe mačku” — the fox went and found a cat.

o: The bear fell from the pear tree and died, and the fox got all the grain
questions.e: The bear falls from the pear tree and dies; the fox is left with all the grain and straw.
